There are five pieces in the Magento world, and the most important one is the community. This is how they fit, and why Magento's future is bright.

In this issue

  • How the Pieces Fit. These five pieces are working together better than they have in years.
  • Who Puts the Community First. Adobe builds for the enterprise, and the Magento Association champions the community.
